rationale: With only 2 minutes to close, any position opened now would be liquidated at market within moments, making meaningful price movement toward a take-profit essentially impossible while still carrying full spread and slippage risk. The stock has already dropped sharply today (gap down ~1.33% plus intraday selling), and the last few candles show a modest uptick but insufficient momentum to justify a directional bet in this timeframe. The risk/reward is unfavorable regardless of direction given the imminent forced close.
